references.text: The Sabbath commandment given in the Ten Commandments, which establishes the holiness of the Sabbath day and the requirement to keep it holy.
The daily offering brought morning and evening, to which the Sabbath offering was added.
The Sabbath mentioned as a holy convocation, part of the Lord's feasts.
The showbread placed before each Sabbath, another weekly ritual offering.
The daily burnt offering to which the Sabbath offering was added.
Ezekiel's vision of the Sabbath offering in the future temple, with six lambs and a ram along with the grain offering.
Jesus refers to the priests' work on the Sabbath in the temple, including the Sabbath offerings.
